description: A black sleeveless, floor-length gown with long black gloves and a multi-strand pearl necklace sits on a dress-form mannequin, standing on a city sidewalk. Behind it, a shop window shows jewellery on display busts, and a takeaway coffee cup and pastry sit on the sill. The style is loose, painterly oil with no visible text, frame or border, and the image runs edge to edge.
